Class PlatformFederatedAccountResolver

java.lang.Object
com.sca4d.app.server.service.PlatformFederatedAccountResolver
All Implemented Interfaces:
com.sca4d.auth.federation.FederatedAccountResolver
@Service public class PlatformFederatedAccountResolver extends Object implements com.sca4d.auth.federation.FederatedAccountResolver
把联邦资料解析为 Sca4d Server Platform Account，并按 Provider 策略执行 JIT。
